import sympy as sp
x,y=sp.symbols('x y',positive=True)
f=1/x+1/y+1/(1-x-y)
sol=sp.solve([sp.diff(f,x),sp.diff(f,y)],[x,y],dict=True)
vals=[sp.nsimplify(f.subs(s)) for s in sol if all(0<float(v)<1 for v in s.values()) and float(1-s[x]-s[y])>0]
m=min(vals)
import itertools
grid=[i/50 for i in range(1,50)]
assert all(float(f.subs({x:a,y:b}))>=float(m)-1e-9 for a,b in itertools.product(grid,grid) if a+b<1)
opts={'A':11,'B':7,'C':5,'D':9}
assert m==opts['D']
for k in 'ABC': assert m!=opts[k]
